name: One Block Server Datapack, Own Island per Player
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.

description: OneBlock skyblock, built for servers: every player who joins gets their own island in the void, automatically. A random item falls out of the block every few seconds. Vanilla datapack — no mods, no client install.
evidence: Data only, no Java code: Horizon's mod browser imports its data; nothing for Kiln to run.
